subagentStart.bash: if [ -n "${HARNESS_RUN_ID:-}" ]; then python3 -m task_harness.cli issue-hook-event --root "$HARNESS_ROOT" --issue "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --run-id "$HARNESS_RUN_ID" --parent-session-id "$HARNESS_PARENT_SESSION_ID" --hook-event subagentStart; else printf '{}\n'; fi

subagentStop.bash: if [ -n "${HARNESS_RUN_ID:-}" ]; then python3 -m task_harness.cli issue-hook-event --root "$HARNESS_ROOT" --issue "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --run-id "$HARNESS_RUN_ID" --parent-session-id "$HARNESS_PARENT_SESSION_ID" --hook-event subagentStop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
